Subject: Quick question regarding [Company Name]

I noticed you’re scaling [specific area], and I help CEOs like you cut [specific pain point] by 20% in under 30 days. Are you open to a brief 10-minute chat next week to see if this fits your current goals?
the ask is for a 20 minute intro call about our AI product.
